register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Start using BoxLead in minutes.
register.legalRequired: Accept the terms and the privacy policy to continue.
register.paidHint: After creating your account we'll ask for your billing details and you'll pay with Mercado Pago.
register.accept: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms and conditions</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
register.invitedEmail: This is the email on your invitation and it can't be changed.
register.terms: By creating your account you accept the [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service) and the [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

plans.empty: There are no plans to choose here for now. Create your account and choose your plan from Billing.
plans.customNote: We build it with you based on what your team needs.
plans.betaValid: Free for a limited time with your invitation for {{email}}.
plans.betaError: We couldn't check your invitation. Reload the page to try again.
plans.betaNone: It's by invitation only. If we invited you, open the link in the email we sent you. To ask for one write to us at
plans.reference: Reference {{reference}}. Charged in pesos at Banco Nación's official selling dollar rate

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.unavailable: For now the password can't be reset from here. Write to us at [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}) from your account email and we'll help you.
recovery.sent: If there's an account with that email, we sent you a link to choose a new password. It expires in 30 minutes. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.
recovery.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
recovery.sendFailed: We couldn't send the request. Check your connection and try again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalid: This link doesn't work. It may have expired, been used already, or you may have asked for another one afterwards.
reset.done: Done, we saved your new password and closed the sessions open on other devices.
reset.tooShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
reset.failed: We couldn't save the password. Check your connection and try again.

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.invalid: This link doesn't work. It may have expired, been used already, or you may have asked for another one afterwards. Open BoxLead to ask for a new one.
confirm.limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again, the link still works.
confirm.failed: We couldn't confirm your email. Check your connection and open the link again.

emailChange.title: Confirm the new email
emailChange.done: Done, your account now uses the new email. From now on you sign in with it.
emailChange.invalid: This link doesn't work. It may have expired, been used already, you may have asked for another one afterwards, or that email may belong to another account. You can request the change again from your account.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.openFailed: We couldn't open the sign-in. Try again from your account.
reauth.unknownProvider: We couldn't tell which account you sign in with. Go back to your account and try again.

socialCallback.failed: We couldn't sign you in with your account. Try again.
socialCallback.cancelled: You cancelled the sign-in. You can try again whenever you want.
socialCallback.title: Signing in
socialCallback.subtitle: We're checking your account. It takes a few seconds.

invitation.invalid: This invitation link doesn't work. It may have expired, been used already or been revoked. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invitation.checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.
invitation.title: You're invited to the BoxLead Beta
invitation.forEmailUntil: The invitation is for <email>{{email}}</email> and is valid until {{date}}.
invitation.accept: Activate the Beta on this account
invitation.haveAccount: Already have an account with that email?

unsubscribe.title: Stop receiving notices
unsubscribe.done: Done, we won't send you these emails anymore. You can turn them back on from Notifications in the app.
unsubscribe.failed: We couldn't unsubscribe you. Check your connection and try again.
unsubscribe.inApp: Notices inside the app don't change.
unsubscribe.missingTitle: This link is missing a part
unsubscribe.missingHint: Open the link again from the last notice email you got to stop receiving emails. You can also choose your notices from Notifications in the app.

scope.NEW_LEAD: You'll stop receiving new lead emails.
scope.HANDOFF: You'll stop receiving emails about conversations the agent hands over to a person.
scope.ALL: You'll stop receiving all BoxLead notice emails.
